name: Battery charger IC (DC input, charge FET, current sense)

stages.description: Input fuse, reverse-polarity diode, input cap
stages.fail_note: No input voltage. Check the input fuse, reverse-polarity diode, and the input source.
Input present at connector but wrong at the regulator input pin. Check the input trace and decoupling.

stages.description: Controller VCC (internal LDO or external bias)
stages.fail_note: Controller VCC missing. The IC cannot run. Check the VCC decoupling cap and the VCC feed (internal LDO or bias winding).
Controller not enabled or no reference. Check EN source and the internal Vref.

stages.description: Adapter detection (ACIN pin senses adapter via divider)
stages.fail_note: Adapter not detected. The charger IC senses the adapter via the ACIN divider. A dead adapter or open sense resistor reads no ACIN, and the charger won't enable charging.

stages.description: Charge FET (controls battery charge current path)
stages.fail_note: Charge FET not enabled. The charger IC drives the charge FET gate. Check the charge-en signal and the FET.

stages.description: Current-sense resistor + sense amp (sets charge current)
stages.fail_note: Current-sense fault. A open sense resistor reads zero current (charger throttles); a short reads overcurrent (charger trips).
Battery interface fault. Check the battery voltage and SMBus communication with the gas gauge. The charger won't charge a pack it cannot communicate with.

stages.description: Non-isolated feedback: output divider to controller FB pin
stages.fail_note: Feedback pin not at expected voltage. Check the FB divider resistors and FB decoupling cap.
PGOOD not asserted or protection tripping. Check the PGOOD pull-up and the OVP/OCP monitors.

fault_patterns.notes: Charger: adapter sense + battery comm are distinctive.
Charger no-output: check adapter sense first.
Output present but wrong voltage. Check the feedback divider and the reference.
Output unstable/oscillating. Check output caps, feedback compensation, ESR.
